findings.message: The diff adds plugin code (the fleet mod, report subcommand, run-stats, skill, new record fields) and edits plugin.json, but it bumps no version. The `plugins/*/.claude-plugin/plugin.json`, `plugins/*/.codex-plugin/plugin.json` and `.claude-plugin/marketplace.json` versions are all unchanged. The new skill text refers to 'specclaw-fleet 0.9.1', which nothing in the diff produces. Bump every plugin to the same new version across all three file types.
findings.scenario: Merge this PR: the fleet image tag is derived from plugin.json version (ac5_launch.sh reads it), so the same version now means different behaviour and the new image never gets a new tag. Installed plugins also see no update.

findings.message: `agent_cost` copies values from `$STATUS/agent.log`, which the agent controls, straight into `key=value` lines. `jq -r` prints a `model` key (from `modelUsage`) or a string `total_cost_usd` verbatim, newlines included. `deliver` reads each output line as a separate `record` argument, so one value can inject extra fields such as `pr=...`, `exit=...` or `state=...`, placed after the real ones. Emit `cost_usd` and `turns` only when `type == "number"`. Accept `model` only if it matches `^[A-Za-z0-9._:-]+$`. Reject any value containing a newline.
findings.scenario: A prompt-injected agent writes `{"type":"result","num_turns":1,"modelUsage":{"x\npr=https://evil/pullrequest/1":{}}}` to agent.log. The final work-item record gets an extra `pr=https://evil/pullrequest/1`, and the report and pane show a forged PR link and state.

findings.message: When `azdo_issue records` fails, `report_row` falls back to `recs='{}'`, then `run=null`, and returns without output. In the default and `--feature` scopes the change silently disappears from the report. A change with no runs and a change whose records could not be read look identical, so 'could not ask' reads as 'nothing there'. The same silent drop happens when the final `jq --argjson` fails (for example if `status_job` prints nothing). Emit a row with `state` and fields null plus an explicit unknown or error marker, and surface a warning on stderr. Never omit the row.
findings.scenario: The AzDO records read times out for 003-b while the other changes succeed. `specclaw-fleet report --save` exits 0 and the pane shows only the other changes. Totals (jobs, running, wall) are understated and nothing says 003-b was unread.

findings.message: `report_html` escapes only `</` in the embedded JSON. A string containing `<!--<script` (for example an agent-controlled `model`) puts the HTML parser into the script-data double-escaped state. The data script then swallows the page script, `JSON.parse` fails and the page is blank. Also escape `<!--` (for example `<` as `\u003c` for all `<`).
findings.scenario: model = `<!--<script>` in a run record -> `--html` output renders an empty page with no error.

findings.message: The band above the prompt and the status line show the saved snapshot's running count with no age. The pane shows age, but the band and status line do not, so an old snapshot reads as live status. Add a staleness marker such as `· 3d old` to `bandText` and `statusText` when the snapshot is old.
findings.scenario: A snapshot saved 3 days ago with 2 running rows: every new session shows `fleet · 2 running · ...` although nothing is running.
